piezas.titulo: Listen: Humour, idioms and cultural references
texto: Listening comprehension of intelligent comedy broadcasts, literary podcasts and cultural talk shows: train yourself to recognise proverbial references instantly («น้ำขึ้นให้รีบตัก», «กบในกะลา») and satirical turns in which irony slips in without any obvious change of formal register. When you hear «เขาพูดล้อเล่น แต่ผู้ฟังบางคนไม่เข้าใจมุก», detect the humorous break and the reaction of the audience.
